data.name: WaterLabel
data.comment: Label of the list where a plant's kind of water is picked, on the plant form.

data.name: WaterHelp
data.value: What the plant is watered with. Rain water or demineralised water suits plants that don't like tap water, like carnivorous ones.
data.comment: Help under the water list on the plant form.

data.name: WeightDry
data.comment: Label of a box on the plant form. The weight of the pot with the soil dry. {0} is the unit, g or oz.

data.name: WeightWatered
data.comment: Label of a box on the plant form. The weight of the pot just after watering. {0} is the unit, g or oz.

data.name: WeightHelp
data.value: Weigh the pot when the soil is dry and again just after watering. Then it can be checked by lifting it.
data.comment: Help under the two weight boxes on the plant form.

data.name: WeighedBeforeRepot
data.comment: Under the weights on a plant's page, when it was repotted after it was weighed.

data.name: DetailWater
data.comment: Heading on a plant's page for the kind of water it gets.

data.name: DetailWeight
data.comment: Heading on a plant's page for the weights of its pot.

data.name: HarvestAmount
data.comment: Label of the box for how much was harvested, in the care form.

data.name: HarvestUnit
data.comment: Label of the choice between grams and pieces for a harvest.

data.name: HarvestPiecesUnit
data.comment: A choice next to the harvest amount, counting in pieces.

data.name: HarvestOptional
data.comment: Placeholder in the harvest amount box.
